title: Producer licensing, appointments and CE
summary: Follow Dana's first years as a Michigan producer: who needs which license, appointment and termination deadlines, what to report, and CE.
objectives: Tell producer, business entity, solicitor and counselor licenses apart
Recall Hire 15, Fire 30, Mail 15, Talk back 30, and the Conduct or Count rule
Know the reporting deadlines for name, address, assumed name and legal actions
Apply the CE numbers and the 90-day grace period rules

scenes.title: Dana opens her agency
scenes.subtitle: Michigan producer licenses, appointments, reporting deadlines and continuing education (CE)

beats.text: Meet Dana. She just got her Michigan producer license, and today she opens her agency in Grand Rapids.
beats.say: Meet Dana. She just got her Michigan producer license, and today she opens her agency in Grand Rapids.

beats.text: Regulation is 15 exam items, and licensing rules are a big part. Let's follow Dana.
beats.say: Regulation is fifteen exam items, and licensing rules are a big part. Let's follow Dana.

beats.text: Tap the glowing spots to meet Dana's team and the director.
beats.say: Tap the glowing spots to meet Dana's team and the director.

reveal.text: A producer needs a license for each line. A business entity needs its own, plus a licensed producer responsible for compliance.
reveal.say: A producer needs a license for each line. A business entity needs its own, plus a licensed producer responsible for compliance.

reveal.text: A licensed solicitor works for a licensed resident producer, under a written contract the producer reports to the director.
reveal.say: A licensed solicitor works for a licensed resident producer, under a written contract the producer reports to the director.

spots.label: Dana: producer (agent)
spots.text: She sells, solicits and negotiates insurance. In Michigan, that takes a producer license for each line, like property and casualty. 'Agent' means producer.

spots.label: The agency: business entity
spots.text: The agency is an LLC: a business entity. Acting as a producer, it needs its own producer license and must name a licensed producer responsible for compliance: Dana.

spots.label: Her helper: solicitor
spots.text: Solicits applications and collects premiums for Dana, a licensed resident producer. A sidekick with 3 L's: Leash (written contract), License, Letter (to the director).

spots.label: The director
spots.text: Michigan's insurance director approves licenses. In the law, 'director' and 'commissioner' mean the same person.

scenes.title: The counselor down the street
scenes.src: MCL 500.1232; MCL 500.1236; question reg-018; memory hook mn_reg-05
scenes.plain: Someone who gives advice or opinions on a policy's benefits, coverage or value. That takes a counselor license.
scenes.example: Tony pays a counselor to review his pizza shop's policies. First they both sign an agreement: the work, the fee, any commission earned as an agent.
scenes.exam: Trap: 'I'll waive my fee if you buy through me' never flies. No counselor license needed: a licensed agent's customary advice, or a Michigan attorney.

beats.text: A counselor gives advice or opinions on a policy's benefits, coverage or value, and needs a counselor license.
beats.say: A counselor gives advice or opinions on a policy's benefits, coverage or value, and needs a counselor license.

beats.text: Tony pays a counselor to review his pizza shop's policies. First, they both sign an agreement. Remember 2-2-0: 2 signatures before the work, 2 years of record-keeping after, 0 fee waivers ever.
beats.say: Tony pays a counselor to review his pizza shop's policies. First, they both sign an agreement. Remember two, two, zero: two signatures before the work, two years of record-keeping after, zero fee waivers ever.

beats.text: Waive your fee if I buy through you?
beats.say: Waive your fee if I buy through you?

beats.text: Never. That's a classic exam trap. The agreement states the work, the fee and any commission earned as an agent, and that the fee can't be waived.
beats.say: Never. That's a classic exam trap. The agreement states the work, the fee and any commission earned as an agent, and that the fee can't be waived.

beats.text: A licensed agent's customary advice, or a Michigan attorney's, needs no counselor license.
beats.say: A licensed agent's customary advice, or a Michigan attorney's, needs no counselor license.

scenes.title: License vs appointment
scenes.src: MCL 500.1208a(1),(2); MCL 500.1201(h); question reg-002; binder: IRMI glossary
scenes.plain: An insurance company naming a producer as its agent. Without it, she can't act as that company's agent or bind its coverage.
scenes.example: Dana's license is like a driver's license. An appointment is a company handing her the keys to its car.
scenes.exam: Trap: a license alone gives no power to commit an insurer. No binding for a company until it appoints her.

beats.text: Dana's license makes her eligible to sell in Michigan. But each company she acts for must appoint her as its agent. That's called an appointment. Without one, she can't bind that company's coverage either.
beats.say: Dana's license makes her eligible to sell in Michigan. But each company she acts for must appoint her as its agent. That's called an appointment. Without one, she can't bind that company's coverage either.

beats.text: The license is like a driver's license. The appointment is the company handing her the keys to its car.
beats.say: The license is like a driver's license. The appointment is the company handing her the keys to its car.

beats.text: Binding gives a customer a binder: temporary proof of coverage until the policy is issued. No appointment, no binding. Watch out for the exam trap: a license alone gives no power to commit an insurer.
beats.say: Binding gives a customer a binder: temporary proof of coverage until the policy is issued. No appointment, no binding. Watch out for the exam trap: a license alone gives no power to commit an insurer.

scenes.title: Dana's call: bind Sam's house today?

beats.text: Dana, can you get my new house covered today?
beats.say: Dana, can you get my new house covered today?

beats.text: The company signed her agency contract this morning, but hasn't appointed her yet. What does Dana do?
beats.say: The company signed her agency contract this morning, but hasn't appointed her yet. What does Dana do?

reveal.text: No appointment, no binding, whatever the license says.
reveal.say: No appointment, no binding, whatever the license says.

options.label: The contract's signed. Bind it now!
options.fail: Signed contract or not, she may not bind for a company until it appoints her. Here, it hasn't yet.

beats.text: Dana binds it. Not yet: the company hasn't appointed her.
beats.say: Dana binds it. Not yet: the company hasn't appointed her.

options.label: Wait until the company appoints her
options.win: A producer may bind for an insurer only after that insurer appoints her. A signed contract or her license alone isn't enough.

beats.text: Hang on, Sam. They haven't appointed me yet.
beats.say: Hang on, Sam. They haven't appointed me yet.

beats.text: Next morning, the company appoints her, and she binds his policy.
beats.say: Next morning, the company appoints her, and she binds his policy.

options.label: Bind it for 15 days while she waits
options.fail: 15 days is the company's deadline to file her appointment. It's no free pass: she can't bind until it appoints her.

beats.text: Dana invents a 15-day trial binder. Nope: 15 days is the company's deadline to file her appointment.
beats.say: Dana invents a fifteen-day trial binder. Nope: fifteen days is the company's deadline to file her appointment.

scenes.title: The company's deadlines
scenes.hook: Hire 15. Fire 30. Mail 15. Talk back 30. Picture a revolving agency door with four stickers: in, out, envelope, reply.
items: Hire 15: appointment filed within 15 days of the contract or first application, whichever is first
Fire 30: director told within 30 days after a termination takes effect, for cause or not
Mail 15: copy to producer within 15 days after telling director; certified or overnight if for cause
Talk back 30: the producer may file written comments within 30 days after receiving it

beats.text: Picture a revolving agency door with four stickers: in, out, envelope, reply. Hire 15: the company files Dana's appointment within 15 days of her contract or first application, whichever comes first.
beats.say: Picture a revolving agency door with four stickers: in, out, envelope, reply. Hire fifteen: the company files Dana's appointment within fifteen days of her contract or first application, whichever comes first.

beats.text: Fire 30: if it ends her contract, for cause or not, it tells the director within 30 days after the effective date.
beats.say: Fire thirty: if it ends her contract, for cause or not, it tells the director within thirty days after the effective date.

beats.text: Mail 15: within 15 days after telling the director, it mails Dana a copy, by certified mail or overnight delivery if for cause.
beats.say: Mail fifteen: within fifteen days after telling the director, it mails Dana a copy, by certified mail or overnight delivery if for cause.

beats.text: Talk back 30: Dana may file written comments within 30 days after receiving it.
beats.say: Talk back thirty: Dana may file written comments within thirty days after receiving it.

scenes.q: An insurer signs an agency contract with Dana on May 1. Her first application to it goes in on May 10. When must it file her notice of appointment?
scenes.why: The notice is due within 15 days of whichever comes first: the contract or the first application. Thirty days is the director's limit to verify eligibility.

beats.text: Your turn. Contract signed May 1, first application May 10. When is Dana's appointment notice due?
beats.say: Your turn. Contract signed May first, first application May tenth. When is Dana's appointment notice due?

reveal.text: Within 15 days of May 1: the contract came first. Thirty days is the director's limit to verify her eligibility, not the filing deadline.
reveal.say: Within fifteen days of May first: the contract came first. Thirty days is the director's limit to verify her eligibility, not the filing deadline.

scenes.title: The boss's call: how to drop Dana
scenes.src: MCL 500.1209(2),(3),(4); MCL 500.1208b(2); questions reg-003, reg-005; memory hooks mn_reg-01, mn_reg-02

beats.text: A year later, the company, an auto and home insurer, wants to drop Dana: just 18 home and auto applications in 12 months. She owns her renewal rights. Which move is legal?
beats.say: A year later, the company, an auto and home insurer, wants to drop Dana: just eighteen home and auto applications in twelve months. She owns her renewal rights. Which move is legal?

reveal.text: Fired for Conduct or Count, not for County.
reveal.say: Fired for Conduct or Count, not for County.

reveal.text: In Michigan, that's what she did or how few applications she sent, never mainly where her business is.
reveal.say: In Michigan, that's what she did or how few applications she sent, never mainly where her business is.

options.label: Drop her for her office's location
options.fail: Auto and home insurers may not end a producer's contract based primarily on where her business is located.

beats.text: The boss circles Grand Rapids. Not allowed: never mainly because of where her business is.
beats.say: The boss circles Grand Rapids. Not allowed: never mainly because of where her business is.

options.label: Drop her for low count; tell the director
options.win: Only conduct or count: under 25 home and auto apps in 12 months, or malfeasance, breach of trust, an Insurance Code violation or failure to perform.

beats.text: Allowed: under 25 home and auto applications in 12 months. It still tells the director within 30 days after it takes effect.
beats.say: Allowed: under twenty-five home and auto applications in twelve months. It still tells the director within thirty days after it takes effect.

options.label: Drop her for low count; skip the paperwork
options.fail: Any termination, for cause or not, even for low production, is reported to the director within 30 days after its effective date.

beats.text: The boss drops Dana and files nothing. Not allowed: even a low-count termination is reported to the director within 30 days.
beats.say: The boss drops Dana and files nothing. Not allowed: even a low-count termination is reported to the director within thirty days.

scenes.title: After the contract ends: what may Dana do?

cards.text: Sam asks a question about his existing policy with that company. Dana answers it.
cards.why: Servicing existing policies is allowed when her agreement is silent about this period.

cards.text: Sam's neighbor wants a new home policy. Dana binds it with that company.
cards.why: Binding a new risk for that insurer needs its approval.

cards.text: Rosa's auto policy with that company comes up for renewal. Dana renews it.
cards.why: Renewing policies for that insurer needs its approval.

cards.text: Jen's existing auto policy with that company runs until it expires. Dana keeps servicing it.
cards.why: She stays responsible for existing policies until they are canceled, replaced or expire.

cards.text: Sam wants a much higher limit on his policy with that company. Dana raises it.
cards.why: A higher limit increases the insurer's obligation. That needs its approval.

beats.text: Her contract has now ended, and it is silent about what happens after that. With her renewal rights, she may service existing policies.
beats.say: Her contract has now ended, and it is silent about what happens after that. With her renewal rights, she may service existing policies.

beats.text: But binding new risks, renewing, or raising the company's obligation needs its approval. Swipe.
beats.say: But binding new risks, renewing, or raising the company's obligation needs its approval. Swipe.

reveal.text: Service, yes; new, renewed or bigger, ask first. The company can't cancel or nonrenew those policies because her contract ended.
reveal.say: Service, yes; new, renewed or bigger, ask first. The company can't cancel or nonrenew those policies because her contract ended.

beats.text: Dana moves. New address, legal name, mailing address or email? Tell the director within 30 days.
beats.say: Dana moves. New address, legal name, mailing address or email? Tell the director within thirty days.

beats.text: Doing business as Big Mitten Insurance? That's an assumed name: tell the director before using it, before the first nail goes into the new sign.
beats.say: Doing business as Big Mitten Insurance? That's an assumed name: tell the director before using it, before the first nail goes into the new sign.

beats.text: Administrative action by another state or another Michigan agency? Report within 30 days after the final disposition.
beats.say: Administrative action by another state or another Michigan agency? Report within thirty days after the final disposition.

beats.text: A criminal prosecution anywhere, felony or not? Within 30 days after the initial pretrial hearing. Admin at the finish line, criminal at the starting gun.
beats.say: A criminal prosecution anywhere, felony or not? Within thirty days after the initial pretrial hearing. Admin at the finish line, criminal at the starting gun.

draw.text: Tell the director before you use it
Finish line: 30 days after final disposition
Starting gun: 30 days after initial pretrial hearing

scenes.title: Continuing education numbers
scenes.src: MCL 500.1206(2); MCL 500.1204c(1),(2),(13); DIFS CE Carryover FAQ; memory hook mn_reg-08
scenes.hook: Every 2 years, spend 1 full day (24 hours) learning, 3 of them on ethics. Leftovers? Take home a dozen (12) at most, and ethics never keeps.
items: No fixed expiration: the license stays in force while CE is done on time
24 hours of approved CE every 2 years
At least 3 of the 24 hours in ethics
Up to 12 extra hours carry over; extra ethics hours never count as next period's ethics

beats.text: Dana's license has no fixed expiration. It stays in force as long as she finishes her continuing education, or CE, on time.
beats.say: Dana's license has no fixed expiration. It stays in force as long as she finishes her continuing education, or C E, on time.

beats.text: In Michigan, every 2 years, she spends 1 full day learning: 24 hours of approved CE.
beats.say: In Michigan, every two years, she spends one full day learning: twenty-four hours of approved C E.

beats.text: At least 3 of them on ethics.
beats.say: At least three of them on ethics.

beats.text: Leftovers? Take home a dozen at most: up to 12 extra hours carry over. And ethics never keeps: extra ethics hours never count as the next period's ethics.
beats.say: Leftovers? Take home a dozen at most: up to twelve extra hours carry over. And ethics never keeps: extra ethics hours never count as the next period's ethics.

scenes.title: Dana's call: Tony wants a policy today
scenes.src: MCL 500.1204c(11); question reg-028; memory hook mn_reg-09

beats.text: Dana's CE deadline passed 20 days ago, hours unfinished. In Michigan, that starts a 90-day grace period: neither normal business nor a shutdown.
beats.say: Dana's C E deadline passed twenty days ago, hours unfinished. In Michigan, that starts a ninety-day grace period: neither normal business nor a shutdown.

beats.text: Dana! Can you get me a new policy today?
beats.say: Dana! Can you get me a new policy today?

beats.text: What does Dana do?
beats.say: What does Dana do?

reveal.text: The 90-day Zamboni: resurface the ice you already have and keep collecting on it, but start no new games.
reveal.say: The ninety-day Zamboni: resurface the ice you already have and keep collecting on it, but start no new games.

reveal.text: Not done after 90 days? The director cancels the license, and Dana must apply again.
reveal.say: Not done after ninety days? The director cancels the license, and Dana must apply again.

options.label: Bind it. It's only a grace period!
options.fail: During the 90-day grace period a producer may not sell, solicit, bind coverage or otherwise act as a producer.

beats.text: Dana binds it. Penalty! In the grace period she can't sell, solicit or bind.
beats.say: Dana binds it. Penalty! In the grace period she can't sell, solicit or bind.

options.label: Sign up for a CE class, then bind it
options.fail: Enrolling in a course doesn't restore selling or binding. In the grace period she may only service old policies and collect their commissions.

beats.text: Dana enrolls in a course, then binds. Penalty again: enrolling doesn't restore selling or binding.
beats.say: Dana enrolls in a course, then binds. Penalty again: enrolling doesn't restore selling or binding.

options.label: Say no; keep servicing old customers
options.win: She may service policies she already sold and receive their commissions. No selling, soliciting, binding or acting as a producer, even if enrolled.

beats.text: Dana turns Tony down, keeps servicing her old customers, and still collects their commissions.
beats.say: Dana turns Tony down, keeps servicing her old customers, and still collects their commissions.

options.label: Shut down: no service, no commissions
options.fail: Too cautious. In the grace period she may still service policies she already sold and receive commissions on them.

beats.text: Dana locks up, ignores Sam's billing question and refuses her commissions. Too far: she may still service old policies and collect their commissions.
beats.say: Dana locks up, ignores Sam's billing question and refuses her commissions. Too far: she may still service old policies and collect their commissions.

scenes.title: Reinstate, move in, temporary license
scenes.hook: A year, a season, a half-year: 12 months to reinstate, 90 days to move in, 180 days on a temp license.
items: 12 months: reinstate a license that lapsed for a non-CE reason, with no exam
90 days: moved to Michigan? Apply as a resident; no prelicensing course or exam for lines held
Up to 180 days: a temporary license with no exam, for example after a producer dies

beats.text: A year, a season, a half-year: 12 months to reinstate, 90 days to move in, 180 days on a temp license. Lapsed for a reason other than CE? Reinstate within 12 months, no exam. Watch out: a license canceled for missing CE doesn't qualify.
beats.say: A year, a season, a half-year: twelve months to reinstate, ninety days to move in, one hundred eighty days on a temp license. Lapsed for a reason other than C E? Reinstate within twelve months, no exam. Watch out: a license canceled for missing C E doesn't qualify.

beats.text: Moving to Michigan with another state's license? Apply as a resident within 90 days, no prelicensing course or exam for lines held.
beats.say: Moving to Michigan with another state's license? Apply as a resident within ninety days, no prelicensing course or exam for lines held.

beats.text: A temporary license, no exam, lasts up to 180 days, for example for the surviving spouse of a producer who dies.
beats.say: A temporary license, no exam, lasts up to one hundred eighty days, for example for the surviving spouse of a producer who dies.

scenes.title: Recap
items: No binding for an insurer until it appoints you
Auto and home: Conduct or Count, not for County
Legal name, address, email changes: 30 days. Assumed name: before use
CE: 24 hours every 2 years, 3 ethics; 90-day service-only grace

beats.text: No binding for an insurer until it appoints you. Hire 15, Fire 30, Mail 15, Talk back 30. And for auto and home insurers, it's Conduct or Count, not for County.
beats.say: No binding for an insurer until it appoints you. Hire fifteen, Fire thirty, Mail fifteen, Talk back thirty. And for auto and home insurers, it's Conduct or Count, not for County.

beats.text: Legal name, address and email changes: 30 days. An assumed name: before you use it. For CE, 24 hours every 2 years, at least 3 of them ethics. And the 90-day grace period: service and commissions only.
beats.say: Legal name, address and email changes: thirty days. An assumed name: before you use it. For C E, twenty-four hours every two years, at least three of them ethics. And the ninety-day grace period: service and commissions only.

beats.text: Note to self: do my CE early.
beats.say: Note to self: do my C E early.
